name: pathmode
description: Turn a vague feature idea into a spec your coding agent can build against. Pathmode interrogates the intent behind a request, writes it to intent.md in your repo, then checks the code that comes back against the outcomes and constraints you agreed to. Free: runs with no account or API key, using the models you already have access to in Claude Code. Connect a Pathmode workspace to sync intent and evidence across a team.

api_key.title: Pathmode API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to run in keyless local mode (specs live in intent.md in your repo). To sync with a Pathmode workspace, create a key at https://pathmode.io/settings (starts with pm_live_).
